project.name: Field Notes
project.summary: Field Notes keeps a researcher's observations and lets an agent find and summarise them. It replaces a folder of text files nobody searches.

nouns.name: note
nouns.purpose: One observation: what was seen, where and when.

nouns.name: summary
nouns.purpose: A written digest of the notes matching a question.

harness.what_it_is: Field Notes keeps a researcher's observations and lets an agent find and summarise them.
harness.who_uses_it: A field researcher, at the end of each day, recording what they saw, and later asking what they know about a place.
harness.today_instead: Text files in a folder, named by date, searched by memory.
harness.failure_in_a_year: Summaries quote notes that do not exist, so the researcher stops trusting them.
harness.goals:
- Every note is findable by place and date.
- A summary cites the notes it came from.
harness.floors: - A summary never cites a note that does not exist.
harness.first_stage_goal: The researcher records a note and finds it again.
harness.first_gate_demo: Ada records a note over HTTP and an agent finds it over MCP. Break it: record a valid note beside one with no place and confirm only the broken one is refused, naming the field.
harness.first_gate_tried_to_break: a note with no place; a date in the future; the same note twice; a valid note beside a broken one.
harness.first_gate_acceptance: Ada records a note and can say: the agent found exactly what I wrote.
harness.later_gates:
Later: one line each, until intake writes them out in full.

- summarise-a-place: Ada asks for a digest of one place and every line cites a note.
harness.interview_transcript:
**Q: Who uses it?**
Answer: "Me, after fieldwork."
